claims.evidence: All 18 deposited design basenames exactly match the 18 distinct raw/*.d acquisition directory names in the ZIP index; __MACOSX entries were excluded.

claims.location: characteristics[deposited group] and six condition groups
claims.value: IP_untreated, IP_no, IP_60, ctrl_untreated, ctrl_no, ctrl_60; three runs each
claims.evidence: Grouping values are copied directly from the deposited design. Their six groups each contain three analytical samples.

The paper says all proteomics samples were triplicates prepared in parallel from cell seeding. Design order assigns a distinct run to each of the three positions per group; cross-condition pairing is not asserted.

claims.location: characteristics[oxidative stress condition] and matching factor
claims.value: untreated; H2O2, no recovery; H2O2, 60 min recovery
claims.evidence: PRIDE states the three conditions were untreated, 1 mM H2O2 for 15 minutes, and one-hour recovery. The suffixes untreated, no, and 60 are interpreted in that order; this run-level expansion is an inference from those sources, not an explicit deposited key.
The paper describes 4H8 antibody capture and non-antibody-conjugated beads as the MS negative control. Deposited group prefixes IP and ctrl map to these arms.

claims.value: Homo sapiens; cell culture; Flp-In-T-REx-293; CVCL_U427; female; normal
claims.evidence: PRIDE and paper identify the human Flp-In T-REx HEK293 parental cell line; Cellosaurus lists the precise derivative and female sex. Cell culture, not anatomical kidney tissue, is the analyzed source. No disease is described for the fetal kidney-derived line, so the cell-lines template's normal term is used.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], [instrument], [cleavage agent details]
claims.evidence: Every deposited run basename contains DDA. PRIDE prose and the paper's MS Methods state timsTOF pro PASEF and trypsin; PRIDE structured instrument field says Pro 2, an unresolved dropdown discrepancy, so the prose model is used.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], [fragment mass tolerance], [modification parameters]
claims.value: 10 ppm; 40 ppm; fixed Carbamidomethyl C, variable Oxidation M and protein N-terminal Acetyl
claims.evidence: MaxQuant mqpar.xml has mainSearchTol=10 with searchTolInPpm=True, TOF MatchTolerance=40 with MatchToleranceInPpm=True, and the named fixed/variable modifications.

limitations: The deposited group code 'no' is interpreted as H2O2 treatment with no recovery, using the project-level three-condition description; it is not explicitly decoded in the design file.
The PRIDE instrument dropdown says timsTOF Pro 2, while its protocol prose and the paper state timsTOF pro; the annotation follows the two prose descriptions.

Cellosaurus gives fetal stage but no numeric age; age uses not available. The optional developmental-stage column is not populated. The offline ontology cache does not resolve the precise Cellosaurus cell-line name in the CLO/BTO/EFO cell-line field.
The reconcile heuristic flags Trypsin and cell culture despite explicit trypsin digestion in the PRIDE and paper protocols and the PRIDE cell-culture source field.
